Directory research 2026-10-04: Site also links a second Facebook URL (facebook.com/decadia.live); the JSON-LD on the site names facebook.com/decadialive/ as the official page, so that one is recorded. YouTube channel is the one linked from the site (also reachable as @DecadiaNY). Booking is via the site's contact form; the only published email is info@decadialive.com (EPK). The site also promotes a Phil Collins/Genesis tribute ('Follow You Follow Me') by the same musicians. Photos are webp files because the image host served webp.
description: An eight-piece New York-area cover band, formed in 2011, with three lead singers. They play dance hits from the '80s along with '70s, '90s, movie-soundtrack and current songs, and also put on a Phil Collins and Genesis tribute show.

logo.alt: Decadia logo: the word DECADIA across a large red letter D inside a black ring on a white paint-splash circle
